name: Pullarr
description: Manage comic metadata, monitoring and Wanted acquisition, Reading Orders, quality profiles and verified upgrades. Browse GetComics Discover; use SABnzbd, NZBGet or qBittorrent with Prowlarr or Torznab. Reviewed archive maintenance preserves page bytes. Configure authentication before exposing beyond your trusted network.

paths.name: Database
paths.description: Persistent database and settings. Back up before upgrades.

paths.name: Logs
paths.description: Persistent application logs; treat as private.

paths.name: Pullarr temporary downloads
paths.description: Pullarr-controlled acquisition workspace. Not the external download client's completed-data path.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Common parent containing library and client downloads, e.g. media/comics and downloads/torrents. Use the same /data layout in clients; hardlinks also require compatible underlying storage.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Pullarr WebUI. Enable authentication before LAN access; never expose directly to the Internet.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: UID controlling container-created file ownership. Pre-authorize this UID on your data share.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone used by container processes, e.g. Etc/UTC.
